source claimUse primitive cell models based on reported cubic and rhombohedral structures; determine most stable magnetic state then bands. HSE06 and zero-order regular approximation treat scalar relativity. Γ-centered k meshes are 6×6×6 for cubic and 3×3×3 for rhombohedral.
